How It Works

A simple monitoring process that compares the portals students use to reach CBSE result services.

  1. 1

    The monitoring service checks configured portal endpoints.

  2. 2

    It measures response latency and availability.

  3. 3

    It processes the monitoring results.

  4. 4

    The dashboard updates the portal status and ranking.

  5. 5

    Students can compare portals and visit the appropriate official destination.

  6. 6

    Students can open the How to Use guide to understand the relevant portal.

Monitoring shows how quickly each portal responded to our checks. It cannot guarantee that a website will open for you or that a result has been released.

About

CBSE Result Portals Monitor is an independent student utility designed to compare the measured response performance and availability of selected result portals.

It helps students identify a currently responding portal and find official instructions for accessing available result services.

This website does not issue results and does not replace official examination websites. It is not owned, operated or endorsed by CBSE or the Government of India. Result availability is decided only by the official announcement.

  • No login or registration needed
  • We never ask for roll numbers, OTPs or passwords
  • Every guide links only to official websites

How to Use · Portal 1 of 7

CBSE Official Website

How to Check Your CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Result Online

Use the official CBSE website to find the Results section, open the link for your class and enter your examination details.

  • Official CBSE website: https://www.cbse.gov.in/ Verified destination
Visit Official Website Jump to written steps

Visual Step-by-Step Guide

Detailed Written Instructions

7 steps · available options and button names can change, so always follow the latest instructions shown on the official website.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Open the Official Website

    Open Google Chrome or any other browser on your phone or computer.

    Type this official CBSE website address:

    https://www.cbse.gov.in/

    Press Enter or tap Search. The CBSE website will open.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Find the Results Section

    On the homepage, look for Results, CBSE Results, or a similar link.

    Tap that link. The website may take you to another page where the available examination results are listed.

    Tip: The website layout may change, so the buttons might look a little different.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Choose Your Class

    Find the result link for your examination:

    • Class 10: Secondary School Examination.
    • Class 12: Senior School Certificate Examination.

    Tap the correct link for your class.

  4. 4

    Step 4: Enter Your Details

    A result page will open with a form.

    Enter the information it asks for, such as:

    • Roll Number.
    • School Number.
    • Admit Card ID, date of birth, or other details, if requested.
    • Security PIN or CAPTCHA, if shown.

    Use your admit card to check your details carefully.

    The information required may vary depending on the result page.

    Important: Enter your own details. Never share your roll number or other personal information publicly.

  5. 5

    Step 5: Submit the Form

    After checking that all the details are correct, tap Submit or Get Result.

    If the page shows an error, check your details and try again.

    If the website is slow, wait a little and retry.

  6. 6

    Step 6: View Your Result

    Your result should appear on the screen if it has been released and the details are correct.

    Carefully check your name, marks, grades, and result status.

  7. 7

    Step 7: Save Your Result

    If the page provides these options, tap Download or Print to save a copy for yourself.

    Keep your result safe. Follow your school’s instructions about collecting your official marksheet.

Troubleshooting

If the Website Does Not Open

  • Check your internet connection.
  • Try again after a few minutes.
  • Use the official CBSE website to find the latest result link.
  • You can also check official digital services such as DigiLocker: https://www.digilocker.gov.in/

Important Safety Tips

  • Always use official websites.
  • Never pay a stranger to get your result.
  • Never share your password or OTP with anyone.
  • Enter your own details. Never share your roll number or other personal information publicly.

Remember: Always use official websites. Never pay a stranger or share your password or OTP with anyone to get your result.

Result availability depends on the official announcement. This website is an independent student utility and is not an official CBSE website.

How to Use · Portal 2 of 7

DigiLocker Results

How to Use DigiLocker to Get Your CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Result

DigiLocker is an official government digital service where students can access and save their digital marksheets and other educational documents.

  • Official DigiLocker website: https://www.digilocker.gov.in/
  • Monitored portal: https://results.digilocker.gov.in/ Verified destination
Visit Official Website Jump to written steps

Visual Step-by-Step Guide

Detailed Written Instructions

7 steps · available options and button names can change, so always follow the latest instructions shown on the official website.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Open the DigiLocker Website

    Open Google Chrome or any browser on your phone or computer.

    Type this address:

    https://www.digilocker.gov.in/

    Press Enter. The DigiLocker homepage will open.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Sign In or Create an Account

    If you already have a DigiLocker account, click Sign In.

    Enter the details requested and complete the verification process.

    If you are a new user, click Sign Up or Create Account and follow the instructions to register.

    Important: Some CBSE students may need a school-provided access code to activate their DigiLocker account. Ask your school if you need one.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Find Your CBSE Documents

    After signing in, look for Issued Documents.

    If your CBSE marksheet is already available, you may find it there.

    If you cannot find it, open Search Documents, Browse Documents, or a similar option.

    Go to the Education category and search for Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE).

  4. 4

    Step 4: Select Your Class

    Choose the document for your examination:

    • Class 10: Secondary School Examination Marksheet.
    • Class 12: Senior School Certificate Examination Marksheet.

    Choose the correct class and examination year.

  5. 5

    Step 5: Enter the Required Details

    The website may ask you for details such as your CBSE roll number and examination year.

    Enter the correct information and click Get Document or the button shown on the screen.

    Follow any additional verification instructions.

  6. 6

    Step 6: View Your Marksheet

    After your details have been verified, your digital marksheet should become available if CBSE has released the document.

    Open it and carefully check your name, roll number, subjects, marks, and other details.

  7. 7

    Step 7: Download and Save It

    Use the Download option if it is available.

    Save the digital marksheet on your phone or computer so you can find it easily when needed.

Troubleshooting

What If Your Marksheet Is Not Available?

Do not worry. Your document may not have been released yet, or you may need to complete account verification.

Check the official CBSE website for updates:

https://www.cbse.gov.in/

You can also ask your school for help.

Important Safety Tips

  • Use the official DigiLocker website.
  • Keep your login details private.
  • Never share your OTP or password with anyone.
  • Never pay a stranger to obtain your result.
  • Check your details carefully before requesting a document.

Remember: DigiLocker makes it easier to access your digital educational documents. The exact buttons may look different from the examples, depending on the website or app version.

Result availability depends on the official announcement. This website is an independent student utility and is not an official CBSE website.

How to Use · Portal 3 of 7

UMANG Official Website

How to Use the UMANG App to Check Your CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Result

UMANG is an official Government of India digital service that provides access to various government services, including supported CBSE result services when available.

  • Official UMANG Website: https://web.umang.gov.in/ Verified destination
Visit Official Website Jump to written steps

Visual Step-by-Step Guide

Detailed Written Instructions

7 steps · available options and button names can change, so always follow the latest instructions shown on the official website.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Download and Open the UMANG App

    Open the Google Play Store on your Android phone or the Apple App Store on your iPhone. Search for UMANG, verify that it is the official app, and tap Install. Once installed, open the app.

    You can also visit the official UMANG website:

    https://web.umang.gov.in/

  2. 2

    Step 2: Sign In or Create an Account

    Open the UMANG app and tap Sign In or the equivalent option. If you already have an account, enter the requested details.

    If you are a new user, select Register or Create Account and follow the instructions to complete registration and any required verification.

    Important: Never share your OTP or password with anyone.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Find the CBSE Service

    After signing in, look for the search bar or the Services section. Type CBSE and select the official Central Board of Secondary Education service from the available results.

  4. 4

    Step 4: Select the Result Option

    Open the CBSE service and look for Result, Examination Result, or a similar option.

    Select the service that matches your examination and year, if available.

    The available options and menu names may vary depending on the app version and the services currently offered.

  5. 5

    Step 5: Choose Your Class and Enter Your Details

    Select the examination that applies to you:

    • Class 10: Secondary School Examination (Class X).
    • Class 12: Senior School Certificate Examination (Class XII).

    Enter the details requested on the result page. These may include your roll number, school number, date of birth, or other examination details.

    Check your information carefully against your admit card or school records before proceeding.

  6. 6

    Step 6: Submit the Form and View Your Result

    After verifying your details, tap Submit, Get Result, or the relevant button displayed on the page.

    If the service is available and your details are accepted, your result should appear on the screen.

    Carefully check your name, roll number, subjects, marks, grades, and result status, as applicable.

    If an error appears, check your details and try again.

  7. 7

    Step 7: Download and Save Your Result

    If a Download or Save option is available, use it to save a copy of your result on your phone or computer.

    You may also use the Print option if provided.

    Keep your result safe and follow your school’s instructions for obtaining your official marksheet.

Troubleshooting

What to Do If You Cannot Find Your Result

  • Check your internet connection.
  • Confirm that you selected the correct class and examination year.
  • Try again later if the service is temporarily unavailable.
  • Check the official CBSE website for the latest announcements and result links.

Official CBSE Website: https://www.cbse.gov.in/

Official DigiLocker Results Portal: https://results.digilocker.gov.in/

Important Safety Tips

  • Use only official websites and apps.
  • Never share your OTP, password, or other sensitive login details.
  • Do not pay strangers who claim they can retrieve your result.
  • Check all your details before submitting the form.

Remember: UMANG provides access to supported government services, but the availability of CBSE results may vary. If the result service is unavailable, use the official CBSE website or DigiLocker to check for alternative access.

Result availability depends on the official announcement. This website is an independent student utility and is not an official CBSE website.

How to Use · Portal 4 of 7

National Portal of India

How to Use the National Portal of India to Find Your CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Result

The National Portal of India is an official government website that helps students find government services and information. Students can use it to find the CBSE examination results service and follow the link to the official result website.

  • Official website: https://www.india.gov.in/ Verified destination
  • CBSE results service listing: https://www.india.gov.in/services/details/cbse-exam-results-current-year
Visit Official Website Jump to written steps

Visual Step-by-Step Guide

Detailed Written Instructions

7 steps · available options and button names can change, so always follow the latest instructions shown on the official website.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Open the National Portal of India

    Open Google Chrome or any browser on your phone or computer.

    Type this address:

    https://www.india.gov.in/

    Press Enter. The National Portal of India homepage will open.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Search for the CBSE Results Service

    Look for the search option on the website.

    Type this service name:

    CBSE Exam Results - Current Year

    Press Enter or click the search icon.

    The website should show matching search results if the service listing is available.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Open the Correct Service Listing

    Look for the listing titled CBSE Exam Results - Current Year.

    Read the description and make sure it refers to the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) and Class 10 (Class X) and Class 12 (Class XII) examinations.

    Click the matching listing to open its details page.

    You can also try opening the service directly using the official link:

    https://www.india.gov.in/services/details/cbse-exam-results-current-year

  4. 4

    Step 4: Find the Official Result Link

    On the service details page, look for a section such as For More Information Visit.

    If a Click Here link or another official destination link is shown, select it.

    The link should take you to the website designated for checking CBSE examination results.

    Important: The exact link text and page layout may change. If the expected link is missing, check the CBSE official website for current result information.

  5. 5

    Step 5: Choose Your Class on the Linked Website

    After opening the linked website, look for the result option for your examination.

    Choose the appropriate option if available:

    • Class 10 (Class X).
    • Class 12 (Class XII).

    Make sure you select the correct examination and year.

  6. 6

    Step 6: Enter the Required Details

    The official result website may ask for information such as your roll number and other examination details.

    Read the instructions carefully and enter the correct information in the requested fields.

    Click Submit, Get Result, or the equivalent button shown on the page.

    Only enter personal details on a website you have verified as an official destination.

  7. 7

    Step 7: View Your Result

    If the results have been announced and the service is available, your result should appear after your information has been accepted.

    Carefully check the details displayed on the screen.

    If the website provides a download or print option, you can use it to keep a copy of your result.

Troubleshooting

What If You Cannot Find the Service or Result?

Do not worry. The service listing, destination links, and result availability may change.

Try these steps:

  • Open the National Portal of India again and search for CBSE Exam Results - Current Year.
  • Visit the official CBSE website for current announcements and result information: https://www.cbse.gov.in/
  • If your result has not been announced or the link is unavailable, check again later or ask your school for guidance.

Important Safety Tips

  • Use the official National Portal of India and verify the website you are redirected to.
  • Never share your password or OTP with another person.
  • Do not pay strangers to obtain your result.
  • Do not enter your personal details on suspicious websites.
  • Follow the latest instructions shown on the official result website.

Remember: The National Portal of India helps you find the CBSE results service. It does not itself guarantee that your result will be displayed on the portal. Your result depends on the availability of the official linked service and the announcement of the examination results.

Result availability depends on the official announcement. This website is an independent student utility and is not an official CBSE website.

How to Use · Portal 5 of 7

CBSE Digital Academic Repository

How to Use the CBSE Digital Academic Repository to Check Class 10 or Class 12 Results

The CBSE Digital Academic Repository is an official CBSE platform for academic records. Students can use it to access digital marksheets, pass certificates, and migration certificates through DigiLocker.

  • Official website: https://cbse.digitallocker.gov.in/ Verified destination
Visit Official Website Jump to written steps

Visual Step-by-Step Guide

Detailed Written Instructions

7 steps · available options and button names can change, so always follow the latest instructions shown on the official website.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Open the Official Website

    Open a browser on your mobile phone, tablet, or computer.

    Visit the official CBSE Digital Academic Repository website:

    https://cbse.digitallocker.gov.in/

    Check that the website address is correct before continuing.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Find the Available Result Links

    On the homepage, look for the result links displayed by CBSE.

    The portal may show links for particular examinations, supplementary results, or re-evaluation results.

    For example, the website has listed these 2026 links:

    • Class XII Supplementary Examination 2026 Results.
    • Class XII Re-evaluation Result 2026.
    • Class X 2nd Board Result 2026.

    The available links may change when CBSE announces new results.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Select the Correct Class and Examination

    Choose the link that matches your class, examination type, and examination year.

    For Class 10, select the relevant Class X result link.

    For Class 12, select the relevant Class XII result link.

    Important: A supplementary, re-evaluation, or second-board result link is not the same as the regular main examination result. Always check the link title before opening it.

  4. 4

    Step 4: Follow the Official Result Link

    Click or tap the result link.

    You may be redirected to a CBSE results page or the DigiLocker Results service.

    Follow the instructions displayed on the official destination page.

    If the repository does not show a link for your examination, do not select an unrelated result link.

  5. 5

    Step 5: Enter the Required Details

    On the result page, enter the details requested by the official website.

    Depending on the examination and result service, these may include your roll number, school number, admit card ID, or other examination details.

    Check your information carefully before submitting the form.

  6. 6

    Step 6: View Your Result

    Select the available option, such as Submit, View Result, or the equivalent button shown on the page.

    If your result is available and your details are correct, your result should appear on the screen.

    Review the displayed information carefully.

  7. 7

    Step 7: Save Your Digital Marksheet

    If you need your digital marksheet or certificate, use DigiLocker.

    Official DigiLocker website:

    https://www.digilocker.gov.in/

    Sign in to your account or create one if needed.

    Then look in Issued Documents for your available CBSE academic documents.

    Some students may need an access code provided by their school to activate their DigiLocker account.

    Follow the current instructions provided by CBSE and your school.

    If your document is not available, check again later or contact your school.

Troubleshooting

What If You Cannot Find Your Result?

If the repository does not display the result you need:

  • Visit the official CBSE website: https://www.cbse.gov.in/
  • Check the latest official announcements or result-related notices.
  • Try the official DigiLocker Results service: https://results.digilocker.gov.in/
  • Ask your school for help if you cannot access your result or digital marksheet.

Important Safety Tips

  • Use official CBSE and DigiLocker websites.
  • Never share your password or OTP with strangers.
  • Do not pay unofficial agents who promise to retrieve your result.
  • Check your personal details before saving or sharing your marksheet.
  • Keep your roll number and other examination information private.

Remember: The CBSE Digital Academic Repository provides access to academic records, but the result links available on its homepage can vary by examination and year.

If your particular result is not listed, use CBSE’s official announcements or the appropriate DigiLocker service.

Delhi Education Department

How to Use the Delhi Education Department Website to Reach CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Results

The Education Department, Government of the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi, provides education-related information and links through its official website. Students can use the “CBSE Result Website” link to reach the CBSE results service.

  • Official website: https://www.edudel.nic.in/ Verified destination
  • CBSE Result Website information page: https://www.edudel.nic.in/edu/CBSEResult.html
Visit Official Website Jump to written steps

Visual Step-by-Step Guide

Detailed Written Instructions

7 steps · available options and button names can change, so always follow the latest instructions shown on the official website.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Open the Official Website

    Open a browser on your mobile phone, tablet, or computer.

    Visit the official Delhi Education Department website:

    https://www.edudel.nic.in/

    Check that the website address is correct before continuing.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Find the Information Links Section

    On the homepage, scroll down and look for the “Information Links” section.

    The website layout may change over time, so check the current homepage carefully.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Select “CBSE Result Website”

    Within the “Information Links” section, look for the link named “CBSE Result Website”.

    Click or tap that link to continue.

    Important: The Delhi Education Department website is a starting point. It does not display your CBSE marks directly.

  4. 4

    Step 4: Continue to the Official Results Service

    The “CBSE Result Website” link may redirect you to an external results service, such as DigiLocker Results.

    Official DigiLocker Results website:

    https://results.digilocker.gov.in/

    Follow the instructions shown on the destination page.

    Check that the website address is correct before entering any personal or examination details.

    If the link takes you to a different official destination, follow the current instructions provided there.

  5. 5

    Step 5: Enter the Required Details

    On the official results page, select the appropriate result option if available.

    Enter the examination details requested by that page.

    The required information may vary depending on the result service and examination.

    Check all details carefully before submitting them.

    Do not enter your details on unrelated or unofficial websites.

  6. 6

    Step 6: View Your Result

    Select the available option, such as Submit or View Result, as shown on the official results page.

    If your result is available and the details you entered are correct, your result should appear on the screen.

    Review the displayed information carefully.

    If the result is not available, check the official announcements and try again later.

  7. 7

    Step 7: Save Your Digital Marksheet

    If you want to access your digital marksheet or certificate, visit the official DigiLocker website:

    https://www.digilocker.gov.in/

    Sign in to your account or create one if needed.

    Look in Issued Documents for your available CBSE academic documents.

    Some students may need an access code provided by their school.

    Follow the current instructions from CBSE, DigiLocker, or your school.

    If your document is not available, check again later or contact your school for help.

Troubleshooting

What If You Cannot Find Your Result?

If you cannot find the result you need:

  • Visit the official CBSE website: https://www.cbse.gov.in/
  • Check the latest official CBSE announcements and result notices.
  • Try the official DigiLocker Results service: https://results.digilocker.gov.in/
  • Ask your school for help if you cannot access your result or digital marksheet.

Important Safety Tips

  • Use official government, CBSE, and DigiLocker websites.
  • Never share your password or OTP with strangers.
  • Do not pay unofficial agents who promise to retrieve your result.
  • Check your personal details before saving or sharing your marksheet.
  • Keep your roll number and other examination information private.

The Delhi Education Department website provides a link to the CBSE results service; it does not show your marks directly.

Follow the “CBSE Result Website” link and then follow the instructions on the official destination page.

Available links and website layouts may change over time.

How to Use · Portal 7 of 7

Delhi Board of School Education (DBSE) Results

How to Check DBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Results

The Delhi Board of School Education (DBSE) provides an official online portal where students can check their Grade 10 and Grade 12 results when they are available. DBSE is a separate board and is different from CBSE.

  • Official website: https://www.edudel.nic.in/dbse/index.html Verified destination
Visit Official Website Jump to written steps

Visual Step-by-Step Guide

Detailed Written Instructions

8 steps · available options and button names can change, so always follow the latest instructions shown on the official website.

Different board: this is the Delhi Board of School Education (DBSE) result page, not the CBSE result portal.

  1. 1

    Step 1: Open the Official DBSE Website

    Open Google Chrome or another web browser on your phone or computer.

    Type this address:

    https://www.edudel.nic.in/dbse/index.html

    Press Enter. The official DBSE Results page will open.

  2. 2

    Step 2: Choose Your Class

    On the result page, you will see separate options for Grade 10 and Grade 12.

    Choose the option that matches your examination:

    • Class 10: Grade 10 — Secondary School Certificate Assessment.
    • Class 12: Grade 12 — Senior Secondary School Certificate Assessment.

    Click the appropriate result link to open the form for your class.

  3. 3

    Step 3: Open the Result Form

    After selecting your class, the corresponding DBSE result form will open.

    Check the heading to make sure it matches your selected grade and examination year.

    The current portal displays results for 2026. Available results and examination years may change.

  4. 4

    Step 4: Enter Your Roll Number

    Find the field labelled Roll Number.

    Enter your roll number exactly as provided in your school records or examination documents.

    Check the number carefully before continuing.

  5. 5

    Step 5: Enter One More Required Detail

    The result form asks for either your Date of Birth or your Student ID.

    Choose one of the following:

    • Date of Birth: Enter your date of birth in the format shown on the form (dd-mm-yyyy).
    • Student ID: Enter your Student ID in the corresponding field.

    You do not need to enter both of these details. Use the option provided by the official form and make sure your information is correct.

  6. 6

    Step 6: Complete Verification

    Look for the Verification Text shown on the page.

    Enter the displayed text into the field labelled Enter Verification Text.

    Make sure the text matches the characters shown in the verification image.

    If the page provides a refresh option and the text is difficult to read, refresh it and try again.

  7. 7

    Step 7: View Your Result

    After entering the required details, submit the form using the button provided on the official page.

    If your details are accepted and the result is available, your result information should appear.

    Carefully check the details displayed, including your roll number, examination class, result status and any other information provided.

    If the form shows an error, check your details and try again.

  8. 8

    Step 8: Save or Print Your Result

    After checking your result, look for any available download, print or save options.

    If a download option is available, use it to save your result.

    If no download option is provided, you may be able to use your browser’s Print option and select Save as PDF.

    Keep a copy for your personal reference. Follow your school’s instructions if you need an official marksheet or certificate.

Troubleshooting

What If You Cannot Check Your Result?

Do not worry. There may be several reasons:

  • Your result may not have been published yet.
  • Your roll number or other details may be incorrect.
  • The website may be temporarily busy or unavailable.
  • You may have selected the wrong class or examination year.

Check your details, wait a little while and try again if the website is busy.

For official updates, visit:

https://www.edudel.nic.in/dbse/index.html

You can also ask your school for assistance if you cannot access your result.

Important Safety Tips

  • Always use the official DBSE website.
  • Check the website address before entering your personal information.
  • Never share your password, OTP or other sensitive information with strangers.
  • Never pay an unknown person who promises to obtain your result.
  • Keep your roll number and Student ID private.
  • Follow the instructions shown on the official result page.

The DBSE result portal is provided through the Delhi Education Department’s website. It is for the Delhi Board of School Education and is different from the CBSE results portal.

The website layout and available options may change over time. The screenshots in this guide are illustrative examples and may not exactly match the live website.

Always follow the latest instructions displayed on the official portal.
